args: Run the scheduled character generation task for ComfyUI. In directory d:/ai_projects/ComfyUI, execute the command: 'cmd /c D:\ai_projects\ComfyUI\venv\Scripts\python.exe tools/hourly_character_task.py --count 1'. Ensure it completes all 9 standalone HD view generations (with 01_face_portrait as native 9:16 HD primary face) and verify the character is ingested into character_library/index.json.
description: Every hour at :00 and :30 (Asia/Shanghai), automatically generates 1 unique Asian female character asset with 9 standalone high-definition views (Google Flow Imagen 3, with 01_face_portrait as native 9:16 HD primary face), extracts face embedding from HD portrait, and syncs into character_library and assets.db.
